title: Could Trump Resign After His Iran Humiliation? Jim Acosta Weighs In
author: John Harwood
content:
President Donald Trump hasn't had a great week. He essentially [surrendered to
Iran](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-lost-iran-war-how-evidence), his [name was
stripped](https://www.washingtonpost.com/style/2026/06/15/trumps-name-is-off-
kennedy-center-tarp-is-still-hiding-proof/) from the Kennedy Center, his
multimillion dollar [reflecting pool
remodel](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/06/16/reflecting-pool-green-algae-
spreads-00963411) is [already
crumbling](https://newrepublic.com/post/212069/lincoln-memorial-reflecting-
pool-disaster-renovation), plus his [health](https://zeteo.com/p/how-bad-is-
trumps-health-medical) appears to be declining and stars are [backing
out](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy2z23122zo) of his "America 250"
celebration. It raises the question: will he finally _quit?_

**" It is very much the latter days of a dictator who is on his way out,"
**says CNN host turned independent journalist **Jim Acosta** to **Zeteo 's
John Harwood**. The two discussed Trump's recent embarrassing endeavors in a
Substack live conversation, in which they answered questions from an audience
of subscribers.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

So, will Trump call it quits? Will he throw JD Vance under the bus over Iran?
How worried should we be about people like Stephen Miller and Peter Thiel?
